integrity: All-size argument by contracting prescribed arrow paths and explicit marked-cycle enumeration; finite exact-arithmetic replay is supplementary; no independent validation.
limitations: Uniform random permutations only; cycle counts and one-line successions of the same permutation; no independence conclusion. Historical-priority checks are nonexhaustive; prior total-cycle covariance is not claimed to be new.
title: Cycle-length orthogonality of ordinary successions in a uniform permutation
